about_the_game:
Nemesis aims to climb the elusive Tower of Mercy for redemption of his past actions. Despite his preparation, the climb does not go as planned. Nemesis suffers from a mysterious illness that takes his strength away from him as he climbs the tower. However, he can combat it with the power of the Tower’s blessing.

Follow Nemesis and a team of various characters through a classic RPG inspired journey as they climb the Tower of Mercy and uncover the dark secrets that lie within. 

  • Explore the tower and learn the strategies to climbing it.

  • Utilize the abilities of many different characters in battle.

  • Take advantage of Mercy skills to fight for control back.

  • Use tomes to learn spells and use them in battle.

  • Meet the different people climbing the Tower and learn their motives for being there.

  • Stare at the axe for 5 hours.

  • Learn the different effects of the Tower and how to combat them.

  • Find the truth of Nemesis and Shirohebi's past...

What this Demo includes:

The first 30 floors of the Tower, and everything in those 30 floors. Other than that, there are no differences from the full game.

short_description: In this roguelite RPG, Nemesis climbs the Tower of Mercy and discovers its secrets. He can meet and team up with other characters, and learn their reasons for climbing the tower. However, he needs to be cautious as he continues, since an entity is taking his strength away.
